candidate_relations.label: Chondroid syringoma of labia majora
candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is adenoid cystic carcinoma, a malignant entity. Chondroid syringoma is a benign mixed tumor of sweat gland origin. Although the clinical record documents prior histopathologic labels of chondroid syringoma, the pattern of repeated rapid recurrences, hypervascular imaging, and the final excision near the fourchette points toward a malignant diagnosis. Chondroid syringoma is a related adnexal neoplasm but represents an incompatible (benign) subtype relative to the requested malignant final diagnostic object.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Benign adnexal tumor vs. malignant adenoid cystic carcinoma; same anatomical site but incompatible malignant/benign designation and histologic subtype

case_quality_flags: Prior histopathology labels (chondroid syringoma, clear cell hidradenoma) may represent misclassification or malignant transformation; the reference diagnosis of adenoid cystic carcinoma is supported by aggressive recurrence pattern and imaging but not explicitly confirmed by the supplied histopathology reports in the record.
